name: 91708 · Chino, CA
findings: ZIP 91708 (Chino) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91708 (Chino) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91708 (Chino) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 17% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
